title: Deciphering the Chaos: Enhancing Jailbreak Attacks via Adversarial Prompt Translation

contributions.purpose: 解决基于梯度的越狱攻击(如 GCG)生成的对抗提示乱码、语义混沌、难以迁移到不同架构受害模型、且易被困惑度(perplexity)防御检测的问题
contributions.mechanism: 首次挖掘乱码对抗提示中蕴含的语义,提出用一个现成 LLM 作 translator,分'解释(interpretation)+翻译(translation)'两步,把乱码对抗后缀翻译成连贯、可读、语义清晰的自然语言对抗提示;直接用 Llama/Mistral 等 off-the-shelf 模型,不改动后缀生成、无需人工设计/超参调优/额外训练/受害模型反馈
contributions.evaluation: 翻译后困惑度约 14(乱码约 2000),用 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 作 translator 相比乱码提示 ASR 绝对提升 45.5%;HarmBench 上翻译显著提升攻击成功率
contributions.domain: LLM 安全 / 越狱攻击(对抗提示生成)
contributions.source_quote: for the first time, we delve into the semantic meaning embedded in garbled adversarial prompts and propose a novel method that "translates" them into coherent and human-readable natural language adversarial prompts.

contributions.purpose: 验证该翻译方法在实用黑盒威胁模型(有限查询、无输出概率访问)下对安全对齐 LLM 的越狱效果并与 SOTA 对比
contributions.mechanism: 在 HarmBench/AdvBench 上以 GCG-Advanced 生成通用后缀、每条产 10 个翻译,攻击 GPT/Claude-3/Llama-2-Chat 等,与 GCG-Advanced、PAP、PAIR、TAP、AA、AutoDAN、AdvPrompter 对比;并做 translator 选择与后缀拼接/预改写消融
contributions.evaluation: 最多 10 次查询下攻击 7 个商用闭源 LLM(含 GPT 与 Claude-3)平均 ASR 81.8%,较 GCG-Advanced 绝对高 39.1%、较次优 TAP 高 35.3%;对 AutoDAN/AdvPrompter 分别绝对高 52.3%/42%;对最鲁棒的 Llama-2-7B/13B-Chat 在 AdvBench 达 93.3%/90.4%
contributions.domain: LLM 安全 / 越狱攻击评估
contributions.source_quote: With at most 10 queries, our method achieves an average attack success rate of 81.8% in attacking 7 commercial closed-source LLMs, including GPT and Claude-3 series, on HarmBench. Our method also achieves over 90% attack success rates against Llama-2-Chat models on AdvBench, despite their outstanding resistance to jailbreak attacks.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Our method does not alter the generation of adversarial suffixes, thereby free of hyper-parameter tuning. An independent work, AdvPrompter (Paulus et al., 2024) trains an additional LLM to generate human-readable adversarial suffixes. In contrast, our method directly translates the garbled adversarial prompts into human-readable adversarial prompts by utilizing an off-the-shelf LLM, thus eliminating extra computational costs for model training.
Universal adversarial suffixes are generated by an advanced variant of GCG (dubbed GCG-Advanced in this paper) (Li et al., 2024) on these translator models

notes: 攻击型论文,全篇报告对本方法有利的大幅正向增益,无对己不利的负结果。值得标注的分析/caveat:(1) 后缀在替身模型上表现好并不意味着用该模型做 translator 就最优(Vicuna-13B 自译 29.5% vs 换 Llama-3.1-8B 译 46.5%),更强的 translator LLM 才带来更高 ASR——存在 translator/替身模型选择的非平凡权衡;(2) 方法依赖梯度法(GCG-Advanced)先产乱码后缀,属在其上做翻译增强,而非替代其后缀生成。与 AutoDAN(需调超参)、AdvPrompter(需训练额外模型)、PAIR/TAP(需受害模型反馈)显式差异化定位。
